messages:
lina-sales: Quick sync — FinBank asked for details on upgrade windows for their air-gapped POC. They need: patch cadence, rollback plan, SBOM, and a pricing approval timeline. Anyone have a short summary we can send them?
ark-engineer: We push delta bundles roughly every 6 weeks. For air-gapped customers we can do monthly or on-demand. Bundles are GPG-signed and include SHA256 checksums.
tara-security: For regulated customers we recommend a standard cadence: quarterly major, monthly security hotfixes. Need explicit maintenance windows agreed up front.
lina-sales: They want zero external egress during install. Confirm offline installer is fully self-contained.
ark-engineer: Yes — offline bundle is self-contained: runtime binaries, model artifacts, license files, and the offline install script. Installer makes no outbound calls. SBOM included as SPDX and human-readable list.
sam-fieldeng: How do we handle rollback? Customer wants a 1-command rollback path.
ark-engineer: We support rollback via redwoodctl: `./redwoodctl rollback --to <bundle-id>` — it restores previous binaries and model artifacts. Note: KV/index schema migrations are the main rollback caveat; recommend DB snapshot before upgrade.
deploy-bot: Bundle 1947654300-xyz signed (GPG key id ABCD1234). checksum: sha256:3f7a... :white_check_mark:
tara-security: Legal also asked for third-party licensing details (OpenSSL, glibc, python packages). We'll hand over the SBOM + license matrix.
lina-sales: Need a pricing quote for weekend upgrade support + offline packaging fee. Also they want SLA language for successful upgrade.
finance-rep: Pricing rough: weekend upgrade assistance (remote) = $12k flat. Onsite engineer = add $6k/day + travel. Offline packaging / airgap signing = $4k one-time.
lina-sales: Can we offer an SLA for upgrade success for the POC?
sam-fieldeng: We can provide a playbook + runbooks and do a canary upgrade on non-prod nodes. Guaranteeing success requires Dedicated + professional services engagement (we'd include acceptance tests). Otherwise we offer best-effort with rollback steps.
tara-security: They asked about FIPS/TLS mode and HSM/KMS integration for key storage.
ark-engineer: FIPS builds are available but are a separate build artifact — not in the default bundle. KMS/HSM integrations require config changes and a short validation window (2–3 weeks for onboarding).
lina-sales: Action list for me to send to customer: 1) SBOM + license matrix (ark) 2) signed bundle proof + checksum instructions (ark) 3) upgrade playbook + rollback steps (sam) 4) formal quote for weekend support + packaging (finance) 5) FIPS availability timeline and extra steps (ark + tara).
ark-engineer: I'll attach a minimal example SBOM and a sample `redwoodctl` install + rollback snippet we can give them.
sam-fieldeng: I'll draft a short upgrade runbook focusing on pre-checks (snapshots, metrics), canary steps, and validation tests.
finance-rep: I'll send a PDF quote and include optional onsite day rates. Lina — ping me when you have customer dates.
lina-sales: Thanks all — I'll reply to FinBank with this summary and ask for their preferred maintenance windows. cc @tara-security for any red flags. :thumbsup:
